items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: A4 acceptance: real project validator with planted transcript rejects a bad grill trace and passes when fixed; stale/double apply keep CAS/idempotent answers; cap MAX_GATE_RETRIES=2 with guided ask_human / autonomous mark_phase_failed; --override-reason needs a reason, writes record+completion in one locked write, visible in validation_overrides[]; canon executed in apply; enforcement off leaves the payload unchanged.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: A raising injected or default gate becomes a [gate-error] ask issue (non-retryable); a raising on_complete hook writes nothing and returns on_complete_failed; malformed or foreign loop state reads as unknown attempt; a CAS-lost terminal surfaces its stale reason.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Override refused without a reason, for ok:false results and for unattended runs; record stamps autonomy and entrypoint; a failed/skipped task can no longer be re-applied to done past gate and recover (root fix in complete_phase_task); no env/config kill switch for the gate.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 36 new tests in the measured run root (two new files) incl. byte-identical non-mutation checks, never-called gates for stale/double applies, and real-validator tests; 671 run-plugin tests green; phase_gate 96%+, single_session_cli and validation_record 100% line coverage.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Gate not called at all with enforcement off; when on, one validator run per apply, outside the lock as on v1.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Seam in its own module orchestrator_pkg/phase_gate.py; lifecycle gains a hook, no new entrypoint (registry unchanged); every touched file under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: run_config validation_overrides[] producer (apply hook) -> schema consumer probed: real CLI subprocess override round-trip validates against run_config.v2.schema.json; v1 update-step --force record shape re-probed unchanged (7 keys).
